t: The Magnusson 3-piece organiser case keeps fasteners, fittings and small parts sorted and accessible on the job. This set includes one large 17-compartment case and two smaller 18-compartment cases, each with hinged plastic lids and removable inserts for custom organisation. Durable polypropylene construction handles site wear, whilst carrying handles make transport between jobs straightforward. The self-contained system stacks neatly in a van or storage unit, and each case holds up to 12kg without compromise.
